h1: Window cleaning in Estates of Lakeway
h1_em: A small pocket, glass done right.
intro: Estates of Lakeway is a small pocket of higher priced homes inside Lakeway city limits. CleanzATX is a Lakeway company, and owners here get the same direct line to Tyler as everyone else.

sections.h2: What Estates of Lakeway homes are like
paragraphs: This is a smaller subdivision with homes priced from about $1M to $1.6M. It has no gate and no HOA on record, so each owner decides how to maintain the property. Because the subdivision is small, you will not find a large crew of neighbors all booking the same day, and each visit is set up for one home.

Homes at this price level tend to have bigger windows, taller entries and more trim detail than average. Owners usually care about how the house looks at the curb and from inside, so the glass is a visible part of upkeep.

sections.h2: What Estates of Lakeway windows deal with
paragraphs: Lakeway's seasons set the cycle. Cedar pollen lands between December and February and live oak pollen follows in March and April. Dust moves in from nearby building sites as the area grows. Trees in the yards bring leaf bits into screens and tracks, and spider webs form fast on shaded eaves.

Sprinkler systems on larger lawns spray the lower row of windows, leaving white spots that harden in the sun. Left alone, those minerals can etch the glass. We rinse with water at near 0 TDS so no new film is left behind. Where spots are already set, removal is $10 per pane.

sections.h2: How we work Estates of Lakeway
paragraphs: No gate means we drive up and start. Poles do the exterior work from the ground, up to three stories, so ladders do not touch stone, stucco or fresh paint. Interior windows are cleaned by hand, with drop cloths and cotton covered ladders where rooms are two story. Many owners pair window cleaning with a house soft wash and a roof soft wash, since both help the home hold its value. Limestone is only soft washed.

Size information for this subdivision varies, so we quote each house. A 4,000 square foot home would be about $400 at $0.10 per square foot, with about three to four hours outside. Interior glass at $15 per window for inside and out adds time.

why: Higher end glass and trim cleaned with soft tools and no harsh chemicals.
Poles keep ladders off stone, stucco and fresh paint.
Each visit is planned around one home in a small pocket.
Direct contact with Tyler for quotes, changes and questions.

faq.q: Do you clean homes in small neighborhoods like this one?
faq.a: Yes. We work in Lakeway every week, including small pockets. Send your address, and we confirm timing, usually within about two weeks.

faq.q: Is there a gate or an HOA to work with?
faq.a: None that we know of. If your street has special rules, tell us in your first text and we follow them.

faq.q: Can you clean roofs and stucco as well?
faq.a: Yes. House soft wash starts at $0.20 per square foot and roof soft wash at $0.25, each with a $400 minimum. The 12V soft wash system keeps pressure low.

faq.q: What does a typical visit cost here?
faq.a: Exterior windows are $10 per window or about $0.10 per square foot. Typical homes run near $350. Both sides at once price at $15 per window. The minimum job is $200.

faq.q: How do I handle hard water spots on glass?
faq.a: Send a photo of the spots. If they are surface mineral deposits, hard water removal is $10 per pane. If the glass is etched, we say so before starting.
